newsitem.title: UK: Virgin and Angel Trains in rolling stock deal.
newsitem.headline: Virgin and Angel Trains in rolling stock deal.

text.p: Virgin Rail, a division of entrepreneur Richard Branson's Virgin Group, said on Monday it had appointed Angel Train Contracts to provide it with procurement and financing for a 750 million stg rolling stock order.

The deal means Angel staff will join Virgin's procurement team for the order, which includes high-speed tilting trains for the West Coast Main Line franchise as well as a new fleet for Virgin Cross Rail.

The procurement team will be headed by Patrick McCall who is joining Virgin from SBC Warburg at the end of May. Brian Barrett, chief executive of Virgin Rail said, "This agreement is an important step...Virgin requires a fresh approach to avoid problems that bedevilled train procurement in the past."
Angel is one of the three rolling stock leasing companies or ROSCOs which were sold off under the government's privatisation of British Rail.
John Prideaux, chairman of Angel Train Contracts, welcomed the chance to manage one of the biggest rolling stock orders since the completion of the rail sell-off.
